description: How Chrome rose from zero to global dominance while Internet Explorer cratered — 2006–2026 (global browser market share).
youtube_description: From zero to near-monopoly: this chart race shows how Chrome, launched in 2008, crushed nearly every competitor and how Internet Explorer — once the web’s gatekeeper — fell from ~77% share to single digits as Microsoft pivoted to Edge. Timeline highlights: Chrome launch (2008), Chrome passes Internet Explorer (2012), Windows 10 & Edge debut (2015), Edge switches to Chromium (2019), and Safari holding strong on mobile. Data compiled from public browser market-share trackers (StatCounter, analytics firms) and historic reporting — every dot represents real global market-share trends. Watch the race, feel the drama, and drop a comment: which browser surprised you the most? Subscribe for more chart-race deep dives and hit the bell to not miss the next one. Sources in the pinned comment. #browserwars #techhistory #chartrace
